proposed_objective.actor_span_score: start_logit[left]+end_logit[right] for valid source-token spans left<=right.
proposed_objective.candidate_ranking_domain_must_be_predecl: All valid source-token actor spans, with deterministic tie ordering and exact source offsets; no held-out references or selector candidates used as labels.
proposed_objective.hard_negative: Highest-scoring valid actor span other than the authenticated exact gold actor span, using only training168 labels.
proposed_objective.loss: Inherited CE scalar + lambda*max(0,margin + hardest_negative_score - gold_span_score).
